name: Aco Inc
old_description: In the heart of Oklahoma City, ACO, Inc., a family-owned innovator since 1972, leads a legacy of craftsmanship and commitment in the polymer industry. With a dynamic blend of proprietary technology, a resilient work ethic spanning three generations, and an unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction, ACO, Inc. shapes ideas into reality within its bustling 90,000 square foot facility.
about:
ACO, Inc. operates from a 90,000-square-foot facility in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in 1972 by Jerry Asner and remains a family-owned business now in its third generation, led by President David Asner, CFO Esther Stephenson, and VP Operations Andrew Feiler.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding and tooling, running 20 molding machines that include proprietary structural foam equipment capable of producing parts up to six feet cubed or 250 pounds. ACO provides a full turnkey operation: free consultation, part design, prototyping, tooling built and maintained in its on-site tool and die shop, CNC machining, CAD drafting, secondary operations, assembly, finishing (engraving, hot stamping, metal forming, bending, sonic welding), and custom jigs and fixtures. It handles small to large batch production runs and stores tooling for the life of each project.

ACO serves customers across a broad range of industries, leveraging its ability to process a wide variety of engineering-grade materials including polyethylene (HDPE, LDPE), polypropylene, ABS, polycarbonate, PPS, nylon, PVC, and specialty alloys such as Static Intercept, Corrosion Intercept, Carmelstat, Noryl, Santoprene, Pelethane, and Durethane.

The company emphasizes its family-owned culture, low employee turnover, and Oklahoma work ethic as differentiators. It guarantees tooling storage for the life of a project, offers one-on-one communication, and aims for faster turnaround times through its integrated in-house workflow.
